paragraphs.source_en: (I) This knot of sorrow—whose hands have twisted it so tightly that even a drop of water cannot pass through? These thousand and ten-thousand strands of worry-knot—who could bear to weave them so mercilessly? Within this knot there are so many traces of tears and bloodstains—may they all transmute into deep blue-green. Loyalty, filial piety, integrity—ha, loyalty, filial piety, and integrity, you have kept this tied. For four thousand years the bones of history have not ceased, yet they have only ground human souls to dust, the Yellow Sea does not rise, Kunlun sighs, and among the ten thousand millions of living beings, heart dies and soul fades, and the central plains weep like ghosts. Cough—loyalty and filial piety! (II) At dawn in the east, the light still returns. How now shall this muddled screen be cleared, if everything is so confused? (III) Do not be frantic. All things depend on human effort; only patience is needed to untie this knot of trouble together. Though it is tight, it is only a knot; a thread can always be found. Do not complain that your fingers are sore and your eyes are tired. Isn't it already visible if you lift your head? Then work hard! (IV) How! In the end, it all unties. Worry is no easy knot, it is a knot of pain. Now then, loosen your face, smile, and shake hands in laborious farewell. From now on, in clear wind and bright days, the scenery along the free road is lovely. Listen—behind, one great burst of joy; all along the path they dispute and untangle the knots, and the worries are gone.

四千年史髏不絕，

黃海不潮，崑崙歎息，

四萬萬生靈，心死神滅，中原鬼泣！

paragraphs.source_zh:
（一）

這煩惱結，是誰家扭得水尖兒難透？

這千縷萬縷煩惱結是誰家忍心機織？

這結裏多少淚痕血跡，應化沈碧！

忠孝節義──咳，忠孝節義謝您維繫

四千年史髏不絕，

卻不過把人道靈魂磨成粉屑，

黃海不潮，崑崙歎息，

四萬萬生靈，心死神滅，中原鬼泣！

咳，忠孝節義！

（二）

東方曉，到底明復出，

如今這盤糊塗帳，

如何清結？

（三）

莫焦急，萬事在人為，只消耐心

共解煩惱結。

雖嚴密，是結，總有絲縷可覓，

莫怨手指兒酸，眼珠兒倦，

可不是抬頭已見，快努力！

（四）

如何！畢竟解散，煩惱難結，煩惱苦結。

來，如今放開容顏喜笑，握手相勞；

此去清風白日，自由道風景好。

聽身後一片聲歡，爭道解散了結兒，

消除了煩惱！
